description: This PHP class 'EmployeeReportingMethodDao' in the namespace 'OrangeHRM\Pim\Dao' manages database operations related to employee reporting relationships, including CRUD operations, search functionalities, and pagination for 'ReportTo' entities within the OrangeHRM system.

classes.name: EmployeeReportingMethodDao
classes.description: Data Access Object class for handling 'ReportTo' entity database interactions related to employee reporting structure.

methods.name: saveEmployeeReportTo
methods.description: Persists a 'ReportTo' entity to the database and returns it.

methods.name: searchImmediateEmployeeSupervisors
methods.description: Searches for immediate supervisors of an employee based on filter parameters, returning a list of results.

methods.name: getSearchEmployeeSupervisorPaginator
methods.description: Creates a paginator object for searching employee supervisors with sorting and pagination.

methods.name: getSearchEmployeeSubordinatePaginator
methods.description: Creates a paginator object for searching employee subordinates with sorting and pagination.

methods.name: getSearchImmediateEmployeeSupervisorsCount
methods.description: Returns the count of immediate supervisors matching the filter parameters.

methods.name: deleteEmployeeSupervisors
methods.description: Deletes supervisor relationships for a given employee with specified IDs.

methods.name: deleteEmployeeSubordinates
methods.description: Deletes subordinate relationships for a given supervisor with specified IDs.

methods.name: searchEmployeeSubordinates
methods.description: Searches for subordinates of an employee based on filter parameters.

methods.name: getSearchEmployeeSubordinatesCount
methods.description: Returns the count of subordinates matching the filter parameters.

methods.name: getEmployeeReportToByEmpNumbers
methods.description: Retrieves a 'ReportTo' record based on supervisor and subordinate employee IDs.

methods.name: getExistingSubordinateIdsForEmpNumber
methods.description: Fetches existing subordinate IDs for a supervisor given a list of IDs.

methods.name: getExistingSupervisorIdsForEmpNumber
methods.description: Fetches existing supervisor IDs for a subordinate given a list of IDs.
